section.heading: Change requests

detail.notFound: This change request doesn't exist or you can't see it.

reject.label: Reason

form.description: The client sees this request and approves or rejects it. You can edit it until they decide.
form.title: Title
form.titlePlaceholder: e.g. Two extra sockets in the kitchen
form.descriptionPlaceholder: What changes, why, and what the options are
form.costHint: In the project's currency. A negative amount is a saving.
form.daysHint: Calendar days. A negative number is time gained.

form.costDecimals: Use at most two decimal places
form.daysWhole: Enter a whole number of days
